daily_narrative.happened: U.S. equities firmed, with the S&P 500 up 0.7% and the Nasdaq up 0.8%, while a sharp selloff in several technology names like AMD, SNDK, LITE, SITM and strong gains in software names such as SHOP, TEAM, RNG and WIX point to stock-specific catalyst dispersion. The move appears to reflect a reflation-friendly rotation, with value and quality outperforming over the month, the VIX lower, and leadership concentrated in Communication Services, Real Estate and Staples rather than cyclicals.
